meta.title: dsh-tauri — Detailed Guide
meta.description: A desktop client for DeepSeek Harness built with Tauri 2: the window, tray, menu, and native capabilities come from Rust + the system WebView, while Harness itself runs the official npm package @deepseek-ai/dsh, i.e. the pure Node service behind dsh web. Neither Electron nor DSH Desktop needs to be installed.
